channel.title: STATIC — Tech, Gaming & Nerd Culture
channel.description: Breaking tech and gaming stories, PC hardware, performance, security and enthusiast culture from STATIC by VoltTech Computer Co.

item.title: Wireless VR Just Ditched the Codec — In the Pixels That Matter
item.description: Pimax Crystal Pro uses eye tracking and an optional 60GHz AirLink to send the GPU's native image to your gaze region without video encoding. Here's what is confirmed and why it matters.

item.title: AMD Just Bought Into the Future of 3D AI
item.description: AMD is acquiring Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for about $8.2 billion. STATIC explains spatial intelligence, 3D world models and why AMD wants the research inside its hardware roadmap.

item.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered Is Gorgeous — And PC Already Needed a Rescue Patch
item.description: The Witcher 3 Remastered is a huge free upgrade. STATIC tested it at 1440p on a Ryzen 7 7800X3D and RTX 5070, then pushed the visuals further with DLSS Swapper.

item.title: Your Regular PS5 Just Got an AI Graphics Upgrade
item.description: Sony is bringing AI-guided QSSR upscaling to the standard PS5, starting with Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei. Here's what changes, what doesn't, and why it matters.

item.title: Kitsune Conquered Comic Con Africa — Inside the VS Gaming Masters 2026 Aftermath
item.description: Kitsune won the 2026 VS Gaming Masters at Comic Con Africa, HighBorn finished second, and SA Counter-Strike took over Hall 6. Results, context and the wider Comic Con aftermath.

item.title: Gears of War: E-Day Is Live Early — PC Gets the Full RTX Treatment
item.description: Gears of War: E-Day early access begins October 1. We break down its Unreal Engine 5.8 PC tech, DLSS 4.5, ray tracing, hardware requirements and 4K targets.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4 Wants 90 FPS to Be the New Recommended
item.description: Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4's official PC specs target 90 FPS on RTX 3060 Ti-class hardware, add ray tracing to every mode, and support DLSS 4.5, FSR Redstone and XeSS 3.

item.title: Xbox Just Made Game Pass Very Hard to Ignore
item.description: Xbox's September 2026 Game Pass wave adds Dune: Awakening, Minecraft Dungeons II and Gears of War: E-Day. STATIC breaks down the dates, tiers and value for South African gamers.

item.title: SA Esports Is Leveling Up — Nearly 500 Students Are Fighting for Pretoria
item.description: Nearly 500 South African university gamers entered the Varsity Esports Split 2 playoff stage. The finals hit UP-Tuks in Pretoria on 2–3 October 2026.

item.title: AMD Just Made Budget PC Building Interesting Again
item.description: AMD quietly launched the Ryzen 5 5500F for AM4 and Ryzen 5 7500 for AM5. Specs, platform costs and which budget CPU makes sense.

item.title: StarCraft Is Back — But Blizzard Just Left RTS Behind
item.description: Blizzard has officially brought StarCraft back, but not as StarCraft III. The 2030 game is a story-driven open-world shooter led by former Far Cry producer Dan Hay.

item.title: South African CS2’s Biggest LAN Is Coming — And It Matters More Than the Prize Money
item.description: South Africa's Top 8 CS2 Masters teams head to Comic Con Africa 2026 for a R340,000 VS Gaming Masters tournament. Why this LAN matters to local Counter-Strike.

item.title: Metroid Ravenous Makes Samus the Predator — And It’s Switch 2-Only
item.description: Metroid Ravenous is Nintendo’s next 2D Metroid for Switch 2, launching January 28, 2027. Here’s what is confirmed about Samus, the new devour mechanic and why it matters.

item.title: Apple’s First Foldable iPhone Is Finally Real — Meet iPhone Duo
item.description: Apple has unveiled iPhone Duo, its first foldable iPhone. Confirmed display specs, A20 Pro hardware, iOS 27 changes, cameras, price and October 23 release date.

item.title: Kojima’s PHYSINT Just Switched Sides — Xbox Will Publish It
item.description: Xbox will publish Hideo Kojima’s PHYSINT, expanding its Kojima Productions partnership beyond OD and into film and television.

item.title: Valheim 1.0 Launches Today — Deep North Ends a Five-Year Early Access Saga
item.description: Valheim 1.0 arrives September 9 with the Deep North, achievements, PS5 and Switch 2 support, full crossplay and a new $29.99 price.

item.title: Zelda Turns 40 Today — Nintendo Has 30 Minutes to Define Its Next Era
item.description: Nintendo marks The Legend of Zelda's 40th anniversary with a dedicated 30-minute Direct today. Here is what is confirmed, what is not, and why the timing matters.

item.title: DLSS 5 Is Here — And It Is Starting to Change What ‘Rendering’ Means
item.description: NBA 2K27 is the first shipping game with Nvidia's DLSS 5 3D-Guided Neural Rendering. Instead of only reconstructing pixels, the model can alter lighting and material appearance under developer control.

item.title: The LEGO PlayStation Is 1,911 Pieces of Weaponised Nostalgia
item.description: Sony and LEGO have turned the original PlayStation into a near-1:1-scale 1,911-piece display set, complete with a wired controller, working buttons and tiny Ape Escape and Gran Turismo dioramas.

item.title: RPCS3 Can Now Play PS3 Games Straight From the Disc
item.description: RPCS3 can now launch PS3 games directly from compatible Blu-ray drives, a major usability win for physical-game preservation.
